title: Kenyan-Style Chicken Stew
description: A fusion of Chinese and Kenyan flavors in this hearty chicken stew. The vibrant spices will transport your taste buds to the markets of Nairobi.

ingredients.name: Vibrant vegetable mix
ingredients.notes: Your favorite colorful mix of bell peppers, carrots, and snap peas

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil, then sauté the onion, ginger, and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the Kenyan-style stew spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the vibrant vegetable mix and cook until slightly tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, soy sauce, and honey. Stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender, about 25-30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
